verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Steel serves a populated llms.txt at docs.steel.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and its docs also ship agent-oriented material such as installable skills and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec that an agent can be pointed at. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the llms.txt or docs, and evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.steel.dev/llms.txt # Steel Documentation
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.steel.dev/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Install Steel CLI and the steel-browser skill so your agent can control a browser.
